originalTitle: LITTLEFOOT | Official Trailer | Land Before Time Reimagining
content: TODAY, WE GET TO SHARE SOMETHING TRULY SPECIAL. Three years of hard work. Countless setbacks. More challenges than I can possibly put into words. And now, after a journey that first began back in 2017, we finally get to show the world what we've been working on and what better day to do it than the 38th anniversary of THE LAND BEFORE TIME. The film that inspired so many of us, and the reason this little dinosaur means so much to so many people. We've brought together an incredible team of artists, animators, musicians, filmmakers and voice actors from around the world. Every single person has given their time, talent and passion to make this happen, simply because they believe in this story. To our cast, hearing these characters come to life through voices I've grown up listening to has been one of the most surreal experiences of my life. To our crew, what you've managed to achieve, often against impossible odds, is nothing short of extraordinary. This isn't just a film about a little dinosaur. It's a love letter to the stories that stay with us, the people who bring them to life, and what can happen when a group of people refuse to give up on a dream. So today, on the anniversary of the film that started it all, we're incredibly proud to finally share this with you. **THE LITTLEFOOT TRAILER IS OUT NOW.** ► Site: https://www.imoriapictures.co.uk/ ► IG! https://www.instagram.com/joeythedirector ► Discord! https://discord.gg/gdQqUFZrB WELCOME TO LITTLEFOOT. ❤️ **Directed by:** Joey Lever **Produced by:** @madeby_imoria **CREW** Co-Creator / Texturing & Rigging: @matthewcreator9 Lead Animator: @ireguamedivad @paubrovs @jimmy.reyes1995 Lighting: @soteldo_cg @raphael.try FX: @arnaurocher_fx Animation: @arbel @reb.eck @hmstevensart @eugenio.delpi @palzhu @jules.arb @emmaeunha, Beatrice Danesi, @maro_xart, Vincenzo Brancato, @haileymarshall.art Envo: @jxmstn Model Artist: @lozymerlot Sound: @giannelli182 @marti_carlux Music: @aaronfullan @zachary_horner **CAST** Summer-Koules Saunders as Littlefoot Larissa Loeffler as Momma Longneck Cristina Vee as Cera Aj LoCascio as Petrie @SarahNatochenny1 as Ducky Joey Lever as Spike sam Retic as The Narrator Mark Meer as Daddy Topps Issie Victoria as Nibbler Emily-Ricks Hahn as Quicktail Jason Griffith as The Leader And to everyone joining us through the cameos, supporting the project, sharing our work and believing in what we're doing, thank you. You're part of this too. #Littlefoot #LandBeforeTime #Animation #FanFilm We do not own the rights to Littlefoot The Land Before Time or any associated characters. All characters names and original concepts belong to Universal Pictures and their respective rights holders. This project is a non commercial fan made tribute created out of love and respect for the original masterpiece.
